appDescription: Start, stop and resume Kimai time entries from the system tray.
notConfigured: The app is not configured yet.
billableOn: Billable to the client - click to keep these hours off the invoice
billableOff: Not billable (internal) - click to bill these hours to the client
billableRowOn: Billable - click to keep this entry off the invoice
billableRowOff: Not billable - click to put this entry on the invoice
billableLocked: Your Kimai account is not allowed to change how this is billed (edit_billable_own_timesheet).
errDescShort: The description is too short — write at least {chars} characters.
errDescGeneric: “{word}” tells the client nothing. Write what you are actually doing.
errBeginFuture: The start cannot be in the future.
errEndBeforeBegin: The end has to be later than the start.
errBillableDenied: Your Kimai account cannot set billable / not billable. The entry was saved the way the project defines it. An administrator grants this with the edit_billable_own_timesheet permission.
errUnexpected: Kimai returned an unexpected response — check the address or your network (for example a Wi-Fi login page).
errTls: The Kimai server certificate is not trusted.
errAuth: Token rejected or expired. Check it in the settings.
warnHttp: The address uses http:// — the token would travel unencrypted.
warnTimezone: Your Kimai timezone ({kimai}) differs from this computer's ({system}). Times are recorded in the Kimai timezone — check your Kimai profile.
optTokenHint: Kimai panel: Profile > API. The token is not your login password.
optMinDescHint: 0 turns the check off. 15 is a good default.
